notes.title: Update v1.16
notes.notes:
[h3]Happy one year anniversary since the launch of Pixel Noir![/h3]

It's patch time again...! 

- [b]Backend Checkpoint Feature Added![/b] When the player enters a new scene, it will save a checkpoint. A checkpoint can be used multiple times no matter how many times you leave and come back into a scene. However, if upon entering a scene, a event immediately triggers, it won't save a checkpoint, but instead use the previous scene as a checkpoint. When the player gets a game over, the game will start over from the checkpoint instead of loading from the last save point. A checkpoint is not a save. If you quit or close the game, you will have to load from your load data. You won't be able to manually load a checkpoint from the load menu.

- [b]Shade has a new summon![/b] It's called [u]Temptation's Rage[/u] which damages an enemy and can cause Enrage and Confusion status effects.

- [b]Fix to characters walking in place[/b] in events. This has been happening sometimes.

notes.title: Update v1.15

A very big long awaited patch has been released!?!? -GTFO....!!!
Let's get into it!

Also resulting in better ladder climbing to account for this new pathfinding system AND any issues with rooftops causing freezes or weird glitches with the layering of objects in a scene.

- [b]Enemy downed response / get up time has been adjusted to a 30 seconds[/b] instead of anything lower than 15 seconds before this patch. Along with that, once you've defeated enemies that popped out from behind buildings or walls, they will now [u]wait to respawn[/u] before popping out again when the player leaves a room and comes back before popping out again.

- [b]Optimized[/b] loading when transitioning between scenes, so the next scene loads faster.

- [b]Implemented[/b] framework for Spanish localization ([i]This will be patched in eventually -TBA)[/i].

- [b]Implemented [/b]saving CRDTech card attributes, so they no longer change every time a tCRDTech match starts. Cards now have permanent attributes but they will differer from new game to new game.

- [b]Fixed [/b]enemies that would run away into another room then if respawned would stay faded out. AND fixed enemies fading out during room transition and stay faded out.

- [b]Fixed [/b]bug where Shade and V-Money would sometimes start at level 1 now correctly start at higher levels.

- [b]Fixed [/b]reload menu showing no bullets when the Detective or Deuce dies / characters who use guns in battle.

- [b]Fixed [/b]police station events respawning in Docks late in ch7 which caused a loop where it can stop the player from progressing.

- [b]Fixed [/b]max item being exceeded when having 99 of an item then picking up another item in the field allowing the player to break the 99 item limit.

-[b] Fixed[/b] rare instances where battles can softfreeze for unknown reasons.

-[b] Fixed[/b] all known outstanding layering issues.....

...And various small polish edits game wide... As always, we welcome all feedback and bug reports to us directly in [url=https://discord.com/invite/RUtWc3RFJs?utm_source=Discord]our Discord[/url]. Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Update #75: The Search For Publishing Continues & A Major Update To Early Access
notes.notes:
[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/042/102/667/38bad8da179af79f2e56a08f43fedb6d_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1693270001&gif-q=50&q=92&s=a21ddbee3297d189538dfc0aafde0cff[/img]

We hope you all are having a great summer! We're excited to bring you another update into the latest developments on your favorite detective RPG, Pixel Noir. Let's dive in!

[h1]The Pub Crawl
[/h1]As we navigate around launch territory, we want to be transparent about our ongoing pursuit of a publishing partner. While we've had exploratory conversations with a number of publishers, we haven't aligned on a deal that we're comfortable with. One common theme we're seeing is that our Early Access launch on Steam has presented a unique challenge that cause most publishers to back away from proposing a deal. We released Early Access to gather feedback from you all, as well as to get the game out to everyone while we finished the rest of the development. However, it was launched with minimal marketing support from our previous publisher. In essence, [b]the Early Access launch has made [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/754320/Pixel_Noir/]Pixel Noir[/url] appear as if it has officially launched when, in reality, it hasn't[/b]. Publishers care about this sort of thing because of the Steam search algorithm prioritizes unreleased games, which effectively means you can market to more people.

To be clear, from a development standpoint, [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/754320/Pixel_Noir/]Pixel Noir[/url] is complete[/b] and now we're using this unforeseen (and semi-unwelcomed) extra time to refine many aspects of the game. The team is committed to continue delivering a great experience by meticulously polishing to perfection and we're determined to find the right launch strategy for the full game.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/042/140/848/804733a62972935b2818f15e6bbf980d_original.png?ixlib=rb-4.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1693508612&gif-q=50&lossless=true&s=ac077bed7c690740a44914ea9f0ba379[/img]


[h1]Early Access Updates
[/h1]While the publisher situation is frustrating, don't think for a minute that we don't have any goodies in store for you! We've been working on addressing Steam feedback to make the game even better. [b]We patched the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/754320/Pixel_Noir/]Pixel Noir Early Access[/url][/b]. Here's a list of what you'll generally find in the new build:

[list]
[*] Enjoy an even more engaging experiences with [b]improved story events, skills, audio, and user interface interactions [/b]
[*] Experience more [b]difficulty balanced battles[/b], ensuring satisfying gameplay
[*] Discover exciting item effects like Lunar Redeye that boosts your adrenaline, Chili Pepper causing Enrage, and Dive Poster as [b]valuable quest items [/b]
[*] Adding to the city atmosphere as [b]police cars now patrol Pinnacle City[/b], making the environment feel alive with the occasional siren passing by
[*] More dynamic gameplay with [b]custom damage events[/b] and [b]environmental hazards[/b] that create new challenges.
[*] Have more fun playing CRDTech with smoother and more enjoyable [b]card game mechanics [/b]
[*] Test your stealth skills as enemies now have a [b]cone of vision[/b].
[*] Enjoy a smoother experience as we introduce [b]refined dungeon mechanics[/b] in critical areas.
[*] Enhance your combat strategy with the [b]new "Pistol Whip" skill[/b], giving you more ways to approach battles.
[*] Jump into the game faster with optimized backend data that [b]minimizes load times[/b] for better seamless gameplay.
[/list]

[h1]Known Issues
[/h1]Here are the known issues for the latest Pixel Noir Eary Access build version 9/12/23.

[list]
[*] Initial load times in selecting New Game or loading saved game data from the title screen clocked in at ~90 seconds. However after loading a game, load times are significantly shorter.
[*] Saved data from previous build versions will be bugged in this version, It's advised to start a New Game from the title screen.
[*] Soft lock in battle with combo tutorial event in ch3 (rare)
[*] Random battles can take place if already in a cinematic which can cause soft-locks or even freezing (very rare)
[*] Premature fade out to enemies in Armory when in mid-room transition (in some instances)
[*] Getting hit by cars next to a roadblock at the end of the street can push the player outside of the environment colliders
[*] Minor issues with graphical asset layering (very rare and can be brief)
[*] Achievements may not be accurate because of a mismatch between old/new build versions
[*] Door SFX can play when failing to fully go through room transition areas
[*] In Ch2: Chapel as a following NPC can step through objects at times
[*] Causing paralysis status while a character (enemy or ally) in battle is going to attack will still allow the character to take their turn. Paralysis status takes effect after the inflicted character's preceding action.
[*] In CRDTech: Using Kato Sheng card’s ability on Deuce's card, causing the use of Deuce card’s ability to back out by pressing Shift (or B / cancel) soft-locks the game
[*] In CRDTech: Kato Sheng card placed last can cause a soft-lock
[*] In CRDTech: Bai Hu card doesn’t use its ability when placed
[*] In CRDTech: Using Meeks card’s ability can cause an opponent to take two turns
[/list]

[h1]More Goodies For The Full Game
[/h1]Since our previous Kickstarter update we've been putting in all kinds of polish. 

[b]Hazards: [/b]We've added damage causing environmental hazards as well as functionality within story events, allowing us to improve immersion both inside and outside story events.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/042/102/363/e3dda699b8b2fd6b1f221d0813ba372d_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1693267503&gif-q=50&q=92&s=6922c57dc4326e8e33c7f73a4dada124[/img]

[i]Sometimes reality hurts.[/i]

[b]More Skills:[/b] We've even added a few skills such as Pistol Whip and some more "summon" discoveries for Shade, our masked vigilante, which should allow players to expand battle strategies.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/042/102/437/99995cb571a3be86ec6aa683436c5396_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1693268217&gif-q=50&q=92&s=b683f085300d9cde7ace590fed4059c1[/img]

[i]Hair of the Dog?[/i]

[b]Skill Point Usage:[/b] We added skill point costs for skill upgrade levels AND we added cost discounts for using skills depending on the gear you have equipped.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/042/102/548/56e4ddbdf552e83718f907e0f3504923_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1693269008&gif-q=50&q=92&s=13e46cfd2e7b149fb1756bbf3e11ec8d[/img]

[i]Skill Bonuses mean skills cost less in battles!
[/i]

[h1]Sweet Jams[/h1]
Finally, we couldn't let this update pass without debuting a new track from renown producer, musician, and all-around-great-guy, [url=http://mustinenterprises.com/][b]Mustin[/b][/url]!!!! A while back we asked him to help with some of the music production on the game. He's the reason why the OST sounds extra-polished, why the audio in the game is all balanced now, and why you're going to have fun listening to the [b]Pixel Noir Arrange Album[/b]! This latest track from him is featured in the game and is called "Four on the Floor". It's played at a popular club in Uptown filled with a DJ and lots of EDM fans. And no, it's not cool that you spilled your beer on me, bro. Alright?

[h1]That's A Wrap For This Update!

notes.title: Update #74: Oh Publisher, Oh Publisher! Wherefore Art Thou Publisher!
notes.notes:
This is going to be a bit of a rollercoaster of an update. We're going to laugh together, cry together, and probably end up in a pottery class together. But before we jump into it, we wanted to let you all know that [b]a few of us are going to be at PAX East this weekend[/b]! Look out for the 30-something-year-old nerds in Pixel Noir T-shirts and say hi if you see us!

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/040/333/178/5a1a8d2214c3e2742bd3cba88b603255_original.jpg?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1679503112&gif-q=50&q=92&s=7af541ad4f28a8bccdbb7030cb16ff92[/img]
[i]It seems like ages since we were at a con! We won't have a booth this time around, but we'll be floating around![/i]

[h1]Getting Down to Brass Tax 
[/h1]As mentioned in[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/pixel-noir/pixel-noir-ps4-ps-vita-pc-mac/posts/3684657] update #72[/url], we ended our business deal with BadLand Publishing due to a myriad of reasons. Here's an overview of what BadLand was supposed to provide and what we've been able to source ourselves:

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/040/332/428/8b593783fb1251accfbc7e592cb39abb_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1679499611&gif-q=50&q=92&s=b6f11ac8407c8ab15045acf3c560a674[/img]
[i]There are several big gaps we need to close. If we launch without a publisher, there's no guarantee we can accomplish all of this.[/i]

As you can see above, since we dropped BadLand Publishing, we were able to successfully fill a few gaps:
[list]
[*] We hired Elevated Play, who is currently helping us in QA/testing the full Steam release. Switch testing will be our next order of business likely starting in May.
[*] We've acquired porting equipment for Playstation and Xbox (Switch is still pending).
[*] We had talks with a few potential publishers, [b]no deal with any of them so far[/b] (but we'll keep you posted). 
[*] We're still on track and working our collective asses off to finish full development by the end April.
[*] A few of us are starting to transition to backer rewards fulfillment. The team is going to kick this workstream off with finalization of the official Pixel Noir OST. 
[/list]

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/040/323/661/affed46e12f8f3685c9b1adafa124230_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1679444258&gif-q=50&q=92&s=197719e62c1f9e879d6738b6b35f7b30[/img]

As we have no publisher yet, we're not in a strong position to go live with the finished game. [b]As a result, we are officially delaying our Steam launch to Q4 or earlier.[/b] The decision to pull back our launch date was due to the fact that we've poured years into this project and want to have a strong launch for our passion project. To recap: [b]we're on track to finish with the game as promised, we just need to line up marketing support before we can launch.[/b]

So bummer: yes, but worth the delay: absolutely yes because it will get into more hands in the long run as well as set us up for delivery of more of the things we had promised with our previous publisher! If you have a publisher in mind for Pixel Noir, PLEASE let either them or us know so we can move forward here...the sooner we get a publisher lined up, the sooner we release!

[b]In lieu of all this info, we will do two rad things:[/b]
[olist]
[*]We'll update the Early Access on Steam sometime in May or June. Less bugs + more polish = more fun!
[*]We will look to accelerate distribution of the OST as part of our fulfillment to backers who purchased digital merchandise. It doesn't fill the void left by a delayed launch date, but if we can't launch, by god, we'll start to deliver on some of the other promises we've made. At the end of the day, you guys have supported us through thick and thin and we appreciate you all. Hopefully you will enjoy some of the sweet tunage from our composers Kunal Majmudar & Hiroki Kikuta. 
[/olist]

Once we get the OST out the door, we will transition efforts to the Arrange Album, which has some incredible talent on it! Here's a sneak peek of the lineup for the Arrange Album:

[previewyoutube=zC7bB2wT5JE;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Development Updates
[/h1]Our next stop on the update rollercoaster ride is dev team updates! notes.title: Update #73: A look back at 2022!
notes.notes:
[h1]            Happy New Year From Team SWDTech!
[/h1]

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/039/643/950/2c5d62ff619a424cc61c3b7bf1a728e7_original.png?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1673453401&gif-q=50&lossless=true&s=622e477d4683c82399e7a0d429c95137[/img]

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/039/629/551/e687a1425a5c5d0a9f5192df06b03240_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1673314637&gif-q=50&q=92&s=4c9a797625a69411b91e611873bf462e[/img]

[previewyoutube=mKO9xTgLlZE;full][/previewyoutube]

Speaking of NPC's, we put in [b]grifters, traders and bums[/b] who you can potentially get some goodies from. We even added some random dialogue to all shops. and we updated all the bartenders in the game, they now sell alcohol!

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/039/629/785/9d4825354435cb5cc41635aa56304da1_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1673316764&gif-q=50&q=92&s=6a8d2de6af2c98363dd3b8e029d999e2[/img]

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/039/643/862/9798b7d7f4b4b9a2973cc05a3de2c730_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1673452674&gif-q=50&q=92&s=58fbda536fff755610d8a8f0a752d80c[/img]

notes.title: Update #72: Breaking Ties & Updating Early Access
notes.notes:
[h1]News news news![/h1]

As we close out 2022, we'll get to our usual updates but first and foremost, we wanted to share the news that [b]we will be ceasing our business agreement with BadLand Publishing. [/b]

BadLand was providing us with Marketing, QA, Localization, and Porting services. The termination of this relationship is unfortunate, but rest assured we've already made alternative arrangements for some of the services BadLand provided and are in talks with other publishers.

While we can't get into more details now about the termination of the agreement, please be aware that we are continuing to move towards our Q2 launch commitment. If we can't arrange for certain deliverables such as Spanish localization for example, we will let you all know. It's a bummer and we are disappointed, but like most bumps in the road, it's not the end of the journey.

And with that, we're moving on to brighter pastures! Let's kick things off with the long-awaited Early Access update, chock full of new features and goodies!  
 
[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/039/436/862/a7f928c6a7599891981a9f6d5e5e2c67_original.png?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1670704242&gif-q=50&lossless=true&s=4c59a4f7878edd42ad1c93a196ace06a[/img]
 
[h1]Updating Early Access
[/h1]
As promised in our last update, we patched Steam Early Access! Chapters 1-4 of Pixel Noir are playable with all of our updated features. Here's a brief recap of what you can expect:
[list]
[*][b]Battle updates galore[/b] including the new skill system, asynchronous turn-based battle system, loads of new party/enemy skills, and many more battle encounters throughout the city.
[*][b]The CRDTech minigame[/b] has seen a major update with more cards, new music/SFX's, and NPC's who will happily battle you for some cash. We included more card abilities, which will make the game more strategic!
[*][b]Lots of audio update[/b]s including 3D audio, text typing, and more--all this helps Pinnacle City come to life with cars now audibly whizzing by you, doors now sounding like they're being opened, conversations between NPC's no longer sounding monotonous, audio transitioning seamlessly between exteriors/interiors and beat-syncing to transition into battle music.
[*][b]Loads more NPC's and intractable objects[/b] around town. We've added grifters, traders, and bums to add to the atmosphere Pinnacle City! 
[*][b]Updates to graphical assets[/b] in the GUI, environments, and sprites--everything looks sharper and cleaner and new character portraits added to boot!
[*][b]Creation tier content[/b] has been added in! Thanks to all our content creation tier backers! In the Early Access version you can expect some of said content.
[*][b]Tons of back-end optimizations[/b], decreasing load times, ensuring that menus bug free.
[*][b]More side-quests[/b] are now available for you to play through and experience!
[*][b]And much more![/b]
[/list]
We can't wait for people to play this new version! Of course, the full game will be coming out next year but, if you can't wait, the Early Access will surely whet your appetite! 
 
[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/039/436/841/5a463f99c76433dd05443d07003032d1_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1670703959&auto=format&frame=1&q=92&s=df7d87902d2be49ec2224223b77d29c8[/img]
[i]*crowd noises* Oooh! Aaaah!
[/i] 
[h1]Development Updates
[/h1]Yes, we're still adding little bits of polish to the game as we continue to work through the bugs in our list. Here's some of the things we've added since the last update in August:

[b]Applied new SFX/BGM to CRDTech card game [/b]- Kunal squeezed out more some more audio to improve CRDTech's experience! Check it out...
 
[previewyoutube=mKO9xTgLlZE;full][/previewyoutube]
 
[b]Audio Voice Effects[/b] - Kunal also added new SFX for character voices. Previously, every NPC and party character in the game had the same typing sounds. Now there are multiple types of typing sounds effectively differentiating the "voices" of characters throughout the city. Check it out in action!!
 
[previewyoutube=u3C1hRPYU0Y;full][/previewyoutube]
 
[b]Gear Skill Bonuses[/b] - Skill bonuses from armor & accessories reduce use costs for learned skills.
 

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/039/436/737/6a051209c3587f8f9392d9f4f2dcfb96_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1670702276&auto=format&frame=1&q=92&s=4126bd31fe85507c0dad563daecf219a[/img]
[i]Menu organization has come a looong way from when we launched the Kickstarter!
[/i] 

[b]Charitable Giving [/b]- Outside of being able to hit them up for intel, you can now help Pinnace City's homeless population out! We've implemented a feature where you can choose to give them a few bucks of your hard-earned money. Sometimes they'll give out an item of appreciation. Remember: it always pays to be good to people, so hopefully this adds a small, but fun dimension to the game.
 
[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/039/436/724/c90dcf8ab1614759a5bd3b5a1252b400_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1670701966&auto=format&frame=1&q=92&s=c311345b352ca27e0f4619f1f2305dcb[/img]

More launch details will arrive next year sometime in Q1, but we wanted to take a moment to thank all of you who continue to support us--we're excited to finally be at this point! Happy holidays & have a great holiday season!

notes.notes:
[h1]Happy Thursday! 
[/h1]
We hope you've all been enjoying your Summer! We have some big news to share, so let's just jump right into it!

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/038/247/801/e7a4f8e01822882e76827b90da4c1ca3_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1660242520&gif-q=50&q=92&s=5cce92cf0d6efd0f123bebbd23edc1a4[/img]

[h1]Launch Window Announcement!!! 
[/h1][i][b]Pixel Noir will launch in Q2 of 2023 on Steam and Nintendo Switch! Additionally, the Early Access will be updated in Q4 of 2022! [/b][/i]


Our publisher, Badland Publishing, will be putting out a press release about it next week, but we wanted to let you VIPs know first! Xbox and Playstation won't be too far behind the initial launch, but we are still sorting out the timing. News on kickstarter backer merch fulfillment will be coming in early 2023, so stay tuned for those deets! 


[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/038/247/418/83b235bc7530232aa15b837ef2c57937_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1660239854&gif-q=50&q=92&s=871e2ff3648408bbb87c7f704e687ed7[/img]
[i]Woooo!! Time to party like it's 65,000,000 BC!
[/i]

Over the years, we've been on the long road of development through countless nights, weekends, and holidays to bring this RPG concept to life. We appreciate all those who have stuck with us through thick and thin!
 

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/038/248/673/117977a988d410dcef29bafb199f6745_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1660248521&gif-q=50&q=92&s=0d3baa69889da5ff98696ed336de965b[/img]


[h1]Steam Indie Showcase
[/h1]
We will be a part of a Steam event called [b]Another Indie Game Showcase, which will be on September 12th, 2022, @ 3PM EST[/b], hosted by our friends over at the Dual Screens podcast. If you haven't checked in on the game in a bit, we think you'll like what you see since battle mechanics, GUI -- nearly everything has evolved since the Early Access launched in 2019!

[url=https://duelscreens.com/announcing-another-indie-game-showcase/][img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/038/196/297/caae1f0bd62f6ae392a8f823f47c8487_original.jpg?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1659814137&gif-q=50&q=92&s=1e82bbe64f3dd06d2cdd33708c5508f0[/img][/url]
[i]Dual Screens Presents: Another Indie Showcase on Steam & Youtube!
[/i]
Okay, let's keep this party going and jump into some...


[h1]Development Updates
[/h1]
[h2]Bounty Hunting
[/h2]
We added a bounty hunting system which is accessible later in the game. You'll be tracking down and apprehending the biggest bottom-feeding scumbags that Pinnacle City has to offer. This feature gives you another way to take on new cases! 

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/038/196/083/0726a87d38911a8d7b6fd2adb151c5e5_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1659812048&gif-q=50&q=92&s=0437d7377f5e0cda8b01a9912a0b0715[/img]
[i]Little known fact: Slimey Saul got his name because he uses *way too much* hair product.
[/i]

[h2]Phone Calls
[/h2]
Throughout the game, don't forget to return to the Detective's apartment to answer your phone! Private-eyes get weird phone calls with even stranger cases to take on.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/038/196/147/45e31241421b022d10bc04cbcfa4f42c_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1659812760&gif-q=50&q=92&s=2318133b664c800e96965466877226cb[/img]
[i]Clearly, the Detective isn't really concerned with missing calls...
[/i]

[h2]Buy A Drink!
[/h2]
Ever felt overwhelmed by all the cases you've taken on? Well, here's something small but fun: you can buy drinks at the various bars around the city!

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/038/196/378/36f4d77f2dd0d2ba5e3af8d2223ea191_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1659815203&gif-q=50&q=92&s=1ca524fb14f7059e02a78908f2a8dc33[/img]
[i]But is the craft beer locally sourced from Pinnacle City??
[/i]

[h2]Battle Positioning Optimization
[/h2]
In testing, we've noticed that getting into random battles throughout the city still resulted in awkward sprite positioning. Sometimes enemies would wander out of frame, and characters would turn in the wrong directions. We completely overhauled positioning battle encounters in the game, resulting in a much more optimized system that allows battles to play beautifully!

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/038/196/104/136a5a270bac3d4afad76f56f7bce2bf_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1659812279&gif-q=50&q=92&s=aa9541a7fb82aa652a6f0f4747846af0[/img]
[i]It might not look like much fun, but this was a massive win in terms of optimizing the game and reducing bugs related to battle positioning!
[/i]

[h2]Other Improvements
[/h2]
In addition to finding and fixing MANY bugs, we also:

[list]
[*] Updated to the 2021.2.9 version of Unity, which helped decrease load times and drove several back-end benefits
[*] Updated colliders, interaction points, and car walk paths/speeds
[*] Added fast travel between the Docks, Boardwalk, & Royal Island
[*] Optimized the layered depth sprite sorting algorithm, putting an end to layering issues between sprites
[*]And made a *ton* of AI, dialogue, and polish tweaks throughout the game
[/list]
 
[h1]Music[/h1]
We've got a juicy sample from our brand new CRDTech theme! A couple of pieces of music will play throughout the CRDTech mini-game, but this tune will play during the actual match. "Risky Gamble" features the incomparable Tim Yarborough of the OneUps on guitar. We hope you enjoy it!

[url=https://soundcloud.com/pixeltonemusic/risky-gamble-sample?utm_source=clipboard&utm_campaign=wtshare&utm_medium=widget&utm_content=https%253A%252F%252Fsoundcloud.com%252Fpixeltonemusic%252Frisky-gamble-sample][img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35093567/3517f1efce85847541fd7106d949fa28f276d23c.gif[/img][/url]

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/038/246/766/0f06f3e20c9870b59772f829af92f1b1_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1660235653&gif-q=50&q=92&s=9e3d250571d99f2e5392472086a99b45[/img]
[i]::shakes head:: jazz musicians, am I right?

notes.title: Update #70: Transitioning From Development To Post-Development
notes.notes:
Hey Everybody! 
As you can probably tell from each successive Kickstarter update, we've been posting fewer update content. That's because we're in the process of finally closing out our development cycle! While you'll continue to see polish and bug fixes up through release, we'll be transitioning from development to porting and localization over the next few months. Let's jump into the rest of the update!

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/036/743/715/8f2aca4288340e3a5dad43721d520990_original.png?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1647978386&gif-q=50&lossless=true&s=b707cd9177e351aea3788a665ecfeb83[/img]

[h1]Release & Porting News
[/h1]Although we are still locking down timing, we plan to launch on Steam first and subsequently on consoles. We were hoping to have more details around release times for you by this update, but we're still in planning discussions with our publisher. Currently, the team is in the middle of heavy testing, so the amount of time needed to find/fix bugs and the defects with the porting/compliance issues that are sure to rise up will greatly influence exactly when we can target a launch date. We know launch times are important to you backers and fans, so we are working to get you this information as soon as we can.


[h1]Shade's Summons
[/h1]We implemented Shade's Summon skills a couple of months ago, which means this mysterious character is ready for battle with sword in hand.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/036/742/814/57864ef956515b8e3352046fb1fd605b_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1647974128&gif-q=50&q=92&s=247d353ae994d068f47ff5d525933018[/img]

[h1]Dealing With Enemies

In addition to adding many enemy skills, we are currently on our fourth pass of balancing for the game. We've fine-tuned enemy encounters during this run and ensured that enemies have appropriate item drops. Battles were already feeling pretty good, but now they feel rewarding too!

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/036/743/641/6684265d05b47d3b5489e847de9e086d_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1647978068&gif-q=50&q=92&s=c1107f6edc1b2ac823af0002748348af[/img]

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/036/743/374/d562d72ef7e886d55d89eb4c7b126062_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1647976765&gif-q=50&q=92&s=65c5bd04c375744ce7bf99ee89bc6af2[/img]

notes.title: Update #69: A Look Back at 2021

We ended the year strong with a lot of great wins (see more details in [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/pixel-noir/pixel-noir-ps4-ps-vita-pc-mac/posts/3378113]update #68[/url]). [/i]

[h2]Random Encounters & A New Way To Escape Battles [/h2]
While exploring the world of Pixel Noir, you never know when someone will try to mug you. Throughout Pinnacle City, baddies will jump out, sometimes alone and sometimes along with more bad dudes. Many enemies will just be hanging out in plain sight, while other enemies might be patrolling or disguise themselves as an inanimate object (like a trash can)! We've even overhauled our "run" mechanic. Previously, as seen in Early Access, you'd select run and the enemy just sort of went "poof" and disappeared. Now, when you select run, a mini game will determine if you can run from a battle.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/036/191/653/be63ca2442ade9435192bb573829cd99_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1643334964&auto=format&gif-q=50&q=92&s=ae6d99af4dd9898d2472ad17dd5928cc[/img]

[/i]

[/i]
[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/036/191/504/5c42af7e05cc374d30c87429a1f4092b_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1643333480&auto=format&gif-q=50&q=92&s=818dea98e13a31d537d5009f092e44c6[/img]
[i]Put those fingers to work if you want to run from a battle!
[/i]

[h2]Visual Effects
[/h2]We've added many visual effects creating much needed polish to the dramatic parts of the game. You'll see flashes of color, new animations for skills, and even heavier use of screen shakes and other camera tricks!

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/036/191/641/d4e09ad64b83aeb6698340a6cf18ea28_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1643334854&auto=format&gif-q=50&q=92&s=011a2f9b6252d88dbabdb694ef36d05d[/img]
[i]You want dramatic effects? We've got em'!
[/i]
[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/036/191/707/e65f152e54ec7dd44bc21bcad06e46f2_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1643335405&auto=format&gif-q=50&q=92&s=79ae0f0cce025a50f3bb2d889f9de150[/img]
[i]Whoa, trippy!
[/i]
[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/036/191/680/ea654c542c07ff9c0883b48fb929be97_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1643335173&auto=format&gif-q=50&q=92&s=0db358dd254173ea0400428f40128baa[/img]
[i]That flash of red really adds a nice "oomph" to Deuce's execution.
[/i]

[h2]The Battle Arena, Hosted By Shovel Knight! 
[/h2]We've added a battle arena that you can access later in the game! 14 rounds with one-time prizes for finishing each round, featuring a cameo by none other than Shovel Knight! We can't tell you what the final round's prize is, but trust us, you'll want it!

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/036/191/494/849545bf347d88ca75d9ba484e1ec30e_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1643333396&auto=format&gif-q=50&q=92&s=d5f3ecb182cc026b59813f41d3958118[/img]
[i]That's a hell of a power, Shovel Knight!
[/i]

[h2]Quality Of Life Enhancements
[/h2]For starters, we’ve been iterating on the menu's user interface to improve intuitiveness as well as display more useful information. We've also added arrows that point to doors and teleports in the game world. You can see them by activating the detective's investigation mode. All main plot lines and cases (side-quests) have been loaded into the Case Manager! This means that you now have clues for each case as well as highlighted map tiles indicating key locations for both main quests and side-quests.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/036/191/558/b31cdddc43bab59e3a3e65997cce32fc_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1643334227&auto=format&gif-q=50&q=92&s=798540dac231edf64ae6eaa136151c8b[/img]

[/i]
[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/036/191/581/0886b4b5b69f8c595358fc23e6167fe9_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1643334341&auto=format&gif-q=50&q=92&s=bcee3563a5dc1a171ef805069ab6a633[/img]
[i]You can see doorway & teleport indicators now!
[/i]
[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/036/191/628/f2965892d884e61ef1c48dceaefed858_original.png?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1643334753&auto=format&gif-q=50&lossless=true&s=e4e44c88683c482f3b325ead287cf553[/img]
[i]It'll be much easier to keep cases moving along even if you step away from the game for a bit.
[/i]

[h2]Items Discovery: Treasures, Traders, Grifters, Black Markets, & Battle Rewards. 
[/h2]Treasure boxes, bundles of cash, and items found through using Investigation Mode are now all in the game. You can also now buy, sell, and get ripped off in the streets of Pinnacle City with the different ways to acquire items and gear off NPCs!

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/036/197/981/8c29ac6dc44fd860453b2cf0c0e7a19c_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1643394971&auto=format&gif-q=50&q=92&s=a113bd266c3749625ac74eb0f8c5217e[/img]
[i]The NPC that owns this garage probably didn't need it anyway ¯\_(ツ)_/¯
[/i]
[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/036/198/239/16903528ef61030254abd36653eb402a_original.png?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1643396637&auto=format&gif-q=50&lossless=true&s=1619256fb95671e6e56a2a58a230bafd[/img]
[i]Investigation Mode can show hidden items all over town!
[/i]
[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/036/198/121/5bf1f08ebccb132d8bc0fbc3c69ec93e_original.png?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1643395875&auto=format&gif-q=50&lossless=true&s=7ba042c69e80e027aa0ed6f81b9790c1[/img]
[i]Think carefully before making a trade, no backsies now!
[/i]
[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/036/197/996/39d3fe39dfe85e449659d52972a5768d_original.png?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1643395086&auto=format&gif-q=50&lossless=true&s=dd13b3cff47e3a3c63b3e979c25c3fcf[/img]
[i]So is the "fork" really a fork? Or could it something awesome??? ....or maybe it really is just a $1000 fork?
[/i]
[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/036/198/007/b5317248efecf8e7d850c23d6a42dcc9_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1643395182&auto=format&gif-q=50&q=92&s=cdf1556738c08c6a6f6d75546bc293e7[/img]
[i]Keep a generous amount of cash on hand for these Black Market dudes... They charge premium prices, but they also have primo wares!
[/i]
[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/036/198/249/f7f6c6fdaa116111dc3ca455c2281cd9_original.png?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1643396715&auto=format&gif-q=50&lossless=true&s=a663af3d9e6394ff12005cde99a5b71f[/img]
[i]And of course, what RPG is complete without enemy item drops!
[/i]

[h2]New Game + 
[/h2]We also rolled out this feature that was funded thanks to a stretch goal! Upon completing the game, New Game + will allow a player to start a new game with their current experience, money, items and skills. This time, however, the player can make different choices, which could lead to different outcomes.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/036/198/329/8621392b3c484e24cb50e9246a357241_original.png?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1643397141&auto=format&gif-q=50&lossless=true&s=e3edd124bd5d961f38e03d618a91762c[/img]
[i]New Game + is officially in the game. Thanks to the Kickstarter backers for bringing this one to life!
[/i]

[h2]Audio [/h2]
We've added 3D sound effects to scenes and moving objects. You can really hear the city come to life as cars drive by, neon signs buzz, trash blows around, waves crash against the beach and more. Additionally doorways with doors now play creeks or other SFX when you transition between rooms.

[previewyoutube=vQDX00KtGQg;full][/previewyoutube]

[previewyoutube=UoNsKvIlJ6U;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Stat Balancing  
[/h2]Testing stat-balancing isn't the most exciting element in the development of an RPG, but it's absolutely essential to delivering a balanced gameplay experience. All seven chapters now feature semi-balanced battle scenarios and gear. And, of course, we'll continue to play-test and tweak difficulty up until launch.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/036/191/537/0f6276a25c6ea8748f800f4c66189adf_original.PNG?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1643334011&auto=format&gif-q=50&lossless=true&s=5b2f72d9f1788a528ffffcf6a9415c7c[/img]

[h2]Peace out, 2021! 
[/h2]To give you an idea of what's to come in 2022, our efforts will be heavily focused around...

[list]
[*] [b]Polish & Bugs:[/b] Implementing the last little bit of polish & stat balancing to get us into post production territory! We also have a handful of small tasks on the coding side, including save/load optimization, several GUI updates, and adding in trophies. Oh, and of course, zapping the bugs that we keep finding and fixing on a daily basis.
[*] [b]Porting, Localization, & Compliance:[/b] As mentioned in previous updates, the good folks over at [url=https://badlandpublishing.com/]Badland Publishing[/url] will be helping us with these tasks. We'll have a better idea of the porting roadmap and release plans later THIS year after we've finished with development.

Well, that's a wrap for our 2021 year end review update! If you're pumped about Pixel Noir, here are three steps you can take to make sure you're in the know:

[i]#HYPETRAIN[/i]

Just to be clear, development will be complete, however there will be several other tasks that need to happen leading up to launch like porting, localization, compliance/QA testing, and just some general marketing planning. We also would like to remind everybody that [b]we plan to address backer rewards closer to launch[/b] so that our team can stay focused on all the pre-launch work and bug crushing.  

In the meantime, if you have still have any questions or would like to switch platforms, feel free to DM us here or on any social media platform that we're on ([url=http://www.bit.ly/swdtehdiscord]Discord[/url], [url=http://www.twitter.com/swdtechgames]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/swdtechgames]Facebook[/url], or [url=https://www.instagram.com/swdtechgames/]Instagram[/url]) and we'll get you squared away! 

[h1]Since The Last Update...
[/h1]

All of the ally and enemy skills are now in the game! We had a blast creating these and of course, they will continue to get polish treatments as time permits prior to launch.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/035/803/800/eb212c99c58c5f147b0ab38fcddf8c10_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1639009586&auto=format&gif-q=50&q=92&s=d09c5c4d576dbe3438318d960e773e4e[/img]
[i]This skill was a total *shocker*[/i]

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/035/803/807/63aa88443a04543767d0345aee9c6ac8_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1639009664&auto=format&gif-q=50&q=92&s=939e1fd4e1cf03c8c340cedefe2771f9[/img]
[i]Screenshake FTW![/i]

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/035/803/815/599961b0485ac1cf2aa35d710af5a5ba_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1639009761&auto=format&gif-q=50&q=92&s=0bdd599175a27779315c7d9bc778be76[/img]
[i]Flamethrower packs a punch![/i]

We started implementation of party member combos a few weeks ago and we're looking to be finished with constructing these sometime this month!

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/035/799/764/1598055f78aedda67e4951b3f7a2298b_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1638979119&auto=format&gif-q=50&q=92&s=9332ac1ab359aa3a6c8953c56565cdd2[/img]
[i]Use combos to wreck your enemies in style![/i]

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/035/799/777/cf4f881ca836af1880ecfd9c0da7e1f9_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1638979215&auto=format&gif-q=50&q=92&s=be320a9644ed20d17846609546b17058[/img]
[i]Even a single change in your party lineup can change the attributes of the combo attack![/i]

For atmosphere, we added 3D sound effects to scenes and moving objects. You can really hear the city come to life as cars drive by, neon signs buzz, trash blows around, waves crash against the beach, and more! Check out a little preview.

[previewyoutube=vQDX00KtGQg;full][/previewyoutube]

We've overhauled our run-from-battle mechanic. Previously, as demo'd in the Early Access, you'd select run and the enemy just, sort of went "poof" and disappeared. Now, when you select run, a mini game will determine if you can run from a battle.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/035/800/109/383d34717244a963c7b544db1eabe2e7_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1638981241&auto=format&gif-q=50&q=92&s=dd7f9a53a86453da370374855b393828[/img]
[i]Escape depends on the levels of your party members in comparison to the enemies' level....and some quick finger work.[/i]

We also added a battle arena that you can access later in the game! 14 rounds with one-time prizes for finishing each round, hosted by none other than Shovel Knight!

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/035/800/005/9982561bfb6ea20c1f97dce6c7d85171_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1638980523&auto=format&gif-q=50&q=92&s=5175708ac2dc8ace2f4b6031ef94ec64[/img]
[i]Thanks to our pals at Yacht Club Games! We're excited to see Shovel Knight make an appearance![/i]

We finished implementing and distributing all learnable party member skills AND collectable CRDTech cards throughout the various story events and game world. Keep an eye out, you can find skills and cards almost anywhere!

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/035/800/069/ecad423a7924e1be4ae52b12e86573a3_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1638980938&auto=format&gif-q=50&q=92&s=db3706d311997cb1107e74126512940b[/img]
[i]Gotta collect 'em all![/i]

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/035/800/095/706f9c48acca3f33ad78ffa83b9fe7a5_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1638981148&auto=format&gif-q=50&q=92&s=c3eeb8ff325189bbc714ed4d7ceb0b70[/img]
[i]You can find skills just about anywhere- story events, case rewards, shops and of course your humble treasure box.[/i]

Last but not least, we made a few UI updates. Skill level indicators and skill level descriptions are now in all the necessary menus.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/035/800/127/b970ea0b6e6287491d861ba78f5fdd27_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1638981358&auto=format&gif-q=50&q=92&s=25001b9aaf3fedb9eb5e9c1ae179d431[/img]
[i]Sometimes it's the little touches that matter most.[/i]

[h1]Alright, you're almost done, but what's left?
[/h1]
[list]
[*]This & That - Miscellaneous stuff mostly covered in the section above: Ally combos. Enemy level implementation.  3D audio. Mini-map environment mapping (making sure that mini-map is accurate). We're pretty close to being finished with this bucket of work!
[*]Bugs, bugs and more bugs - Yes, these still are popping up, but we are tracking less every week (We expect this to be a constant up until and after we release on steam.)
[*]Battle Difficulty Balancing - We just finished our 3rd pass of this most tedious task in testing!
[*]Polish - We are continuing to fine-tune audio, cinematics, dialogue, and flesh out extra features such as CRDTech encounters. This will be an ongoing task until we launch
[/list]

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/035/809/714/05585e740d57da83275d88bb84a5a576_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1639069539&auto=format&gif-q=50&q=92&s=301ff9bfb1da1ff5358b88477f98b4c7[/img]
[i]Of course we'll be crunching through the holidays![/i]

[h1]Closing Up The Update Bag
[/h1]
If you're excited about this project, join the [url=http://www.bit.ly/swdtechdiscord]SWDTech Games Discord server[/url] or follow us on any number of social platforms! We're going to be putting out more and more content and teasers up until the release, so keep an eye out!

notes.title: Update #66: Cruisin' Right Along!
notes.notes:
It’s been a busy couple of months here at SWDTech!! We’ve got a lot to share with you, so let’s jump right in!

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/033/700/728/5c3aeb7b15761046b2cfb9c792a07614_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1622316801&auto=format&gif-q=50&q=92&s=2ba42fb7bb47b591e9972ac5c6d4a736[/img]

[h1]Vita Talk[/h1]
We had a little controversy with the Vita news a couple of months ago where we thought Sony was going to shut down it's online store for Vita. Apparently some very vocal Vita fans spoke up with passion to this news which forced Sony to keep its digital marketplace online (meaning we all can still buy the games on the marketplace). However, this move leaves developers like us in the dust because Sony won't be allowing new digitally released games to populate it's online store for Vita. ([url=https://blog.playstation.com/2021/04/19/playstation-store-on-ps3-and-ps-vita-will-continue-operations/]Source 1: Official PS blog[/url] - [url=https://www.playstationlifestyle.net/2021/05/07/no-more-playstation-vita-games/]Source 2 Playstationlifestyle.net's article[/url]). We may be able to homebrew it digitally, but we are still looking into figuring this option out. Obviously this news also means that there won't be a physical release of Pixel Noir on the Vita. That said, we've got a laundry list of porting to do, so we're going to have to consider our approach here. Hopefully, Sony rethinks this decision and allows game developers to add new titles in the future.

With that we're off to the development updates! We're continuing to progress through our list of [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/pixel-noir/pixel-noir-ps4-ps-vita-pc-mac/posts/3116339]open items from last update[/url]. 

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/033/708/335/f1ac6edeb5a8d0230302692f35de9b76_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1622397540&auto=format&gif-q=50&q=92&s=7e063686cf4f4e2b8cc864544babee43[/img]
[i]::continues scanning news from Sony::
[/i]
[h1]First Pass Of Stat-Balancing Completed![/h1]
Stat-balancing isn't the most exciting element in the development of an RPG, but it's absolutely essential to delivering a balanced gameplay experience. As of this update, all seven chapters now feature balanced allies, enemies, and gear. But we are going to do another pass or two to tweak difficulty as necessary but that will take far less time than this initial pass. 

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/033/699/831/cceebe5af446f9b38bdda07418134495_original.png?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1622311324&auto=format&frame=1&lossless=true&s=2da8ea24ad4ca165f771dee23072f2f1[/img]

Along with balancing, we've also been adding semi-scripted random battles throughout the game. Watch your step in Pinnacle City, you never know when someone will try to mug you!

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/033/700/075/30a5793672a940480afb7e5e34392413_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1622312874&auto=format&gif-q=50&q=92&s=b8a88b1657b84d6870f71cf1c22b5a71[/img]
[i]Run away!
[/i]
[h1]Case Manager Now Integrated With City's Map[/h1]
All main plot lines and cases (side quests) have been loaded into the case manager! This means that you will now have clues for each case as well as highlighted map tiles indicating key locations for almost any selected case.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/033/700/234/8e3b5386fea0aaa9202fbb2c827a5e05_original.png?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1622313766&auto=format&frame=1&lossless=true&s=e1a0efeb9afa586ab8447438d00bd137[/img]
[i]As a detective, it's up to you to figure out where your next clue lies within that highlighted tile...[/i] 

[h1]Teleport & Doorway Indicators [/h1]
Just for a small quality of life improvement, we added arrows that point to doors and teleports in the game world by activating the detective's investigation mode.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/033/762/364/d6fa37b708d5153c2d40142bc131a50f_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1622740569&auto=format&gif-q=50&q=92&s=e5a1e59887f67ece01e9e3715e0be2dc[/img]
[i]FF7 called... They want their teleport arrows back![/i]

[h1]Arena Battles + Shovel Knight! [/h1]
That's right folks, we are adding a battle arena into the game hosted by our very own cameo appearance of Shovel Knight! He runs a virtual arena in the Tronics shop Downtown where you can battle the game's various enemies for prizes!

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/033/760/894/55d4068d7011ae3f94062cb130bd1eab_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1622733308&auto=format&gif-q=50&q=92&s=bb47dce242ade418e0b541a1b77bbca1[/img]
[i]Look into my eyes.... *poof* You're in battle land![/i]

[h1]New Game +[/h1]
As you might recall, New Game + was a stretch goal. This feature will allow a player, upon completing the game, to start a new game with their experience, money, items and skills, but this time the player can make different choices, which could lead to different outcomes.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/033/762/750/5e27762b69cf78522ce1ce2da708db06_original.png?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1622742726&auto=format&frame=1&lossless=true&s=d5a263e56bf806f5821bedf76b751a4e[/img]
[i]How many cigarettes can the you get the Detective to smoke in your *SECOND* playthrough?[/i]

[h1]Bug Crushing / Polish Mode[/h1]
From the beginning of the year to this point we've been play testing rigorously to eliminate any game/emersion breaking bugs as well as adding finishing touches throughout the game. For example, door sounds were added to every environment in the game. Check it out!

[previewyoutube=ty_SJyip1GY;full][/previewyoutube]

We've also added some cool flash and sprite coloring effects to our cinematics for more of a dramatic effect!

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/033/700/561/f1bfaf1219bb33313b15734bc6092751_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1622315829&auto=format&gif-q=50&q=92&s=6047afc01ad21b619776640e9e59afb8[/img]
[i]A bloody, dramatic *Color Flash*![/i]

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/033/700/642/29f0cdef391651cdd114190443444687_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1622316271&auto=format&gif-q=50&q=92&s=b57fdcdaeb1d23e0d98d83e28c9d46e1[/img]
[i]Background color filter test sample.[/i]

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/033/708/181/2d800eda0dc8a541e3b065f6070bce34_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1622396293&auto=format&gif-q=50&q=92&s=00cd2f75e4530af02c47e6c2c5aabee3[/img]
[i]Off screen explosions![/i]

[h1]Audio Sneak Peek[/h1]
Finally, here's a sample of the Uptown over world theme! Uptown is a nice part of town where Pinnacle City's more affluent citizens live. Here you can find the Apparel Mall, the Tronics Factory, and the Pinnacle City Gazette! Check it out:

https://soundcloud.com/pixeltonemusic/uptown-overworld-sample

[h1]That’s it for this month’s update! [/h1]

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/033/708/208/7cc40bd132735faf9954170c494995ed_original.gif?ixlib=rb-4.0.2&w=700&fit=max&v=1622396506&auto=format&gif-q=50&q=92&s=2595ff819e5c264b7f9ce8f8275f8aa8[/img]

https://swdtechgames.com/roadmap"]Roadmap[/url] / [url="https://twitter.com/swdtechdevbot"]Twitter bot[/url]. notes.title: Update #65: And Now, An Update From Our Creative Director
notes.notes:
Hey everybody, 

This is Len Stuart, creative director behind Pixel Noir and co-founder of SWDTech Games. I decided to personally come out and give you a brief summary of how I see things at the moment to let you know what's happening at this stage of development.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/032/599/729/ed0198bc76fcb1c77548217b2c8bd727_original.jpg?ixlib=rb-2.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1614822451&auto=format&frame=1&q=92&s=968ecfc8aabc3704d2e1f8f19521e5b5[/img]
[i]You can't see it from this picture, but yes I am chained to my desk. :D[/i]

While implementation is complete, a lengthy polish/bug extermination phase has been underway in these last four months to increase stability. In parallel, we are continuously testing to make the game balanced via player/enemy character stat and gear tuning, while also factoring in collectables/skills. It's a large game for as small as it is... (if that makes sense? -may only make sense to me!) 

Have a look at our funny but frustrating bug collection...

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/032/592/904/9fd03f553bc539d41ab6d9de8f8eafec_original.gif?ixlib=rb-2.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1614789814&auto=format&gif-q=50&q=92&s=78141ac7891b497e8548e72536eaea38[/img]

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/032/593/165/f9fc5f759a96af32a2d373504415de4f_original.gif?ixlib=rb-2.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1614790655&auto=format&gif-q=50&q=92&s=4929ec4b5096b3ab262b1cf056c0d0fd[/img]

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/032/597/167/ca4f0f20723b9e7ff6cf06b139b01041_original.gif?ixlib=rb-2.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1614807187&auto=format&gif-q=50&q=92&s=4a7d41acdb0b518fbe714e439b2e8d54[/img]

For those asking about a release date, although we are very close to finishing from a development standpoint, we‘re not yet ready to predict a release date. We want to put out a nicely polished game upon release because Pixel Noir is a project that has always focused on the quality of our game instead of profit. Not only that, but for as long as we all have been working on this project (and all the time you all have waited), we firmly believe it's worth putting in the effort at this point to make sure we can all be proud of the game we brought to life--dev, backer, and fan alike.

Now more from the bug collection...

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/032/606/765/53b3db2abf0e37c7c40d220a18358787_original.gif?ixlib=rb-2.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1614872563&auto=format&gif-q=50&q=92&s=2faf10bbaaa0b216acdd9e68bf711411[/img]
[i]She... walks her own path.[/i]

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/032/596/652/2e53d502eb27c2d754d61ac84ce1ecb8_original.gif?ixlib=rb-2.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1614804919&auto=format&gif-q=50&q=92&s=ce92fb5eb46f09c6bec902646f46d7c3[/img]
[i]...Don't ask...[/i]

With all that said, let me remind you of the things we are currently working on at the moment with Pixel Noir:

[list]
[*][b]Battle / Skill / Stat Balancing [/b] - This is the longest, most tedious with the battle testing and all that must be done over and over and over.... 
[*][b]Collectible Placement / Shop Stocking / Traders + Grifters + Black Markets[/b] - Items and gear need to be factored into balancing as there is some complexity in the later chapters of the game. We've done this for about 35% of the game as of this update. 
[*][b]Battle Encounter Placement[/b] - Turn down a wrong alley in Pinnacle Ci--never mind you get the point. (25% finished) 
[*][b]Bug, bugs and more bugs[/b] - Of course, we are still dealing with these... However we are tracking less with every play test!! 
[*][b]Polish[/b] - Continuing to fine-tune audio, cinematics, dialogue, and flesh out extra features such as CRDTech encounters. This will be ongoing until we finish... [/list]

As outlined in [b]Update #63[/b], this phase is one of the longest parts of our development cycle outside of the environment implementation that we finished earlier last year. So just sit tight, stay tuned for more, and know that we’re still motivated to get this game out to everyone!!

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/032/596/782/ad1eed7296321f76ca70e58a44f0c930_original.gif?ixlib=rb-2.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1614805498&auto=format&gif-q=50&q=92&s=854e0780360d55f500352d7f7bbd5781[/img]

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/032/593/046/34f83cc944d9a7e08349ea33716fd83e_original.gif?ixlib=rb-2.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1614790306&auto=format&gif-q=50&q=92&s=86ee0df903dfbb9532d392e0d1c9c169[/img]
[i]Waiting like...[/i]

Your next update will be on [b][i]June 3rd[/b][/i]. As always, follow our official [url=http://www.swdtechgames.com/roadmap]Roadmap[/url] / [url=https://twitter.com/swdtechdevbot]Twitter bot[/url] and don't forget to check follow [url=https://www.twitch.tv/leolicos]Leo's Pixel Noir dev streams on Thursday nights[/url] to check in on progress in realtime!


//Len and the rest of Team SWDTech

notes.title: Update #64: A look back on 2020!
notes.notes:
[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/031/782/220/46b6411bb1b32d7a054108e799f3c491_original.gif?ixlib=rb-2.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1608317079&auto=format&gif-q=50&q=92&s=9b666a3b9ceb3f5e606c93d1e5cfe53c[/img]
🌲🌲🌲🌲🌲

2020 gave us a lot of... stuff: Covid-19. Murder Hornets (remember those?). The Cyberpunk 2077 launch...

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/031/786/567/187cf3187797ccc69b7fb74d965179d2_original.jpeg?ixlib=rb-2.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1608362985&auto=format&frame=1&q=92&s=4821c070f6d0c67751d640845f77ff20[/img]
[i]Cyberpunk!![/i]

But not all of it was bad! Pixel Noir grew by leaps and bounds this year! As we stated in our last update, we're in the process of polishing up and transitioning to post-production, so it's been quite a journey this year! But for now let's take a trip down memory lane!

We finished creating all music & added the Muzak's shop where you can listen to some sweet, pixelly jams! Check out the audio sneak peeks that we've been gathering: 

https://soundcloud.com/pixeltonemusic/sets/pixel-noir-samples

[h1]In Memoriam...[/h1]
We also wanted to take a minute to talk about one of our team members, who left an indelible mark on Pixel Noir. Shane Stevens was part of our art team and was responsible for most of the character / monster sprites and misc. animations in the game. He passed in late September after a long battle with an aggressive abdominal cancer. Needless to say, without Shane's talent, Pixel Noir would be nowhere near as unique as it is. 

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/031/782/339/7fc4355f51f6ad36e6e2b272b38e4351_original.gif?ixlib=rb-2.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1608317861&auto=format&gif-q=50&q=92&s=9d2c22cd912d8d9a7e8f645a19a92ac2[/img]

Rest in peace, Shane. We're lucky to have worked with you and we'll miss you!

From our 16-bit family to yours, we hope everybody has a great holiday and a safe and happy new year! 


//The Pixel Noir Team

notes.title: Update #60: All The Environments Are IN! + An Updated Battle System
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! In the midst of the global pandemic, we continue to make great progress on Pixel Noir. We have some great dev news this month, so let's not waste any time and jump right into it! 

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/028/694/860/cf64db6e529f8b6ac9572af6a9c34308_original.gif?ixlib=rb-2.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1586579958&auto=format&gif-q=50&q=92&s=174f8692e9158d84c2723c57c60c126b[/img]
[i]::coding intesifies::[/i]

[h1]100% Implementation Of Environments!
[/h1]As we've said in previous updates, one of the biggest challenges over the past few years of development has been the slow and steady implementation of Pixel Noir's expansive environments. Every layer of detail needed to be hand placed while every nook had to be meticulously crafted to keep our Detective from falling off the world. Here are the new areas we put in for the rest of the game (not included in our Early Access). We know these area maps are a tad small but they should give you a sense of what was involved here with all exteriors, interiors and alleyways included in these images.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/028/699/223/1c90736bf3f1e92856427eccd5c8291f_original.jpg?ixlib=rb-2.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1586628102&auto=format&frame=1&q=92&s=337d5f04950a780c7b552a6bae8bb5f9[/img]

[i]You'll start Chapter 5 by casing the Boardwalk for clues between playing at the arcade and climbing the lighthouse.[/i]

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/028/699/259/bf7b9d34e756aeb21f05c13d2175b1db_original.jpg?ixlib=rb-2.1.0&w=700&fit=max&v=1586628471&auto=format&frame=1&q=92&s=652b0167727b79d9df297d583cc3c465[/img]
